Goat Fuel is now on Energy Drink Ratings, with 6 flavors added to the catalog this week.

Label values per 12 fl oz can, all zero sugar:
• Black Cherry Ginger Ale: 200 mg caffeine
• Pineapple Cream Soda: 200 mg caffeine
• Watermelon Fruit Punch: 150 mg caffeine
• Gummy Bear: 150 mg caffeine
• Blueberry Lemonade: 150 mg caffeine
• Tropical Berry: 150 mg caffeine

None of them has a rating yet. Tried one? Your rating will be the first.

Which would you open first, Black Cherry Ginger Ale or Pineapple Cream Soda?
